title: MLOps
prereqs: pip install scikit-learn fastapi httpx pytest
Docker + kind for the serving challenge
description: Operationalize machine learning: reproducible training, leakage-free data & feature pipelines & feature stores, experiment tracking & a model registry, model serving (REST/gRPC, batching, KServe/BentoML), CI/CD for ML & retraining, and production monitoring (data/concept drift via PSI/KS, performance decay) — each a runnable, pytest-judged exercise, with a finale that serves a model on Kubernetes.
